text.text: *Wave closed.* 4 filed  ·  6 folded into existing work  ·  1 parked. Every disposition passed a human confirm.

*What came in* — three weeks of accumulated classifier signal drained in one sitting, and the shape was unusual: only two of the eleven items were fresh reports. The rest were things we already knew that had *changed status*, which is why six folded into existing tickets rather than becoming new ones.

*What changed* — four filed, six folded, one parked: the ratio you want from a mature area. Both questions that had been open across waves closed here, one of them because the answer arrived *in-thread* rather than on the board — that path is now worth relying on. The fabrication cap moved from unclear to decided and no longer blocks the resync. The parked item needs a measurement nobody has run yet; filing it first would have produced a ticket nobody could action.
